name: ecomap
description: EcoMap Community - a generic, layer-based community map for local ecological initiatives.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @ecomap/shared" "npm run dev -w @ecomap/api" "npm run dev -w @ecomap/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ecomap/shared && npm run build -w @ecomap/api && npm run build -w @ecomap/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
